name: DISPLACE-M
description: DISPLACE-M is a benchmark for conversational medical speech understanding in noisy, spontaneous, multi-speaker settings. It covers diarization, speech recognition, topic identification, and dialogue summarization for real-world goal-oriented medical conversations.
evaluation_method: Task-specific metrics: diarization error rate (DER), word error rate (WER), classification accuracy / F1 for topic identification, and ROUGE / similar summarization metrics for dialogue summarization.
general_score_metric: DER / WER and task-specific NLP metrics
notes: Dataset contains 40 hours of development recordings and 15 hours of blind evaluation recordings. The benchmark spans multiple speech and language tasks in challenging medical conversational environments.
